definitions.gloss: general meeting, general assembly, plenary session
definitions.explanation: A meeting of all members of an organization, company, or body. In corporate contexts, refers specifically to a shareholders' meeting. Also used for assemblies of clubs, associations, and international organizations.

examples.japanese: {株主|かぶぬし}{総会|そうかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{総会|そうかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{役員|やくいん}→役員：11329_yakuin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選出|せんしゅつ}する→選出する：17345_senshutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: Officers are elected at the once-a-year general meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国連|こくれん}→国連：12035_kokuren⟧{総会|そうかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{決議|けつぎ}→決議：16467_ketsugi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{採択|さいたく}→採択：06784_saitaku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new resolution was adopted at the United Nations General Assembly.

notes:
USAGE:
The most common usage is {株主|かぶぬし}{総会|そうかい} (shareholders' meeting), a legally required annual meeting for corporations. Also used for any organization's plenary meeting where all members gather, such as a club or association. ⟦{国連|こくれん}→国連：12035_kokuren⟧{総会|そうかい} (UN General Assembly) is another well-known compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {株主|かぶぬし}{総会|そうかい}: shareholders' meeting
- ⟦{国連|こくれん}→国連：12035_kokuren⟧{総会|そうかい}: UN General Assembly
- ⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧{総会|そうかい}: regular general meeting
- ⟦{臨時|りんじ}→臨時：04092_rinji⟧{総会|そうかい}: extraordinary general meeting
- {総会|そうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: hold a general meeting
